#Background Keema descended among Roke's Hellites and saw many deaths caused by these predators/murderers and got excited. He blew a breath of virus into freshly dead Hellites on the field, which ate away the corpse slowly starting from the lung. The virus then emitted a gas, causing the corpse to ‘cough’-- where it gets the name Carrion Flu from.

Carrion Flu is an airborne disease affecting organic beings that are not protected by gods that have domain over life. If there are any living beings near the corpse while it coughs, the flu can be transferred into the living being. Once it infects a living being, they start to feel shortness of breath due to the virus eating away the lung. After a while, they start to cough and lose strength. Over time, the virus will eventually cause death of the infected. The virus persists for couple days after the death of its host. The disease will onset onto a population if proper burial/removal of corpses are not held.

There is a dormant period of one day in god’s time before it starts to take effect onto living beings. The known cure is to consume a Naga Fruit which is protected by Flora in Tree of Life, but there is only so much supply. Only other intervention for this disease is for a god to to lift its curse through negotiations with any god that has domain over death/misfortune/disease. If the disease were to make it to a habitat of the living being, the habitat will experience a 20% decrease in population over a period of two days.

#Actions available * Any gods with domain over misfortune can place this disease onto races after a war or a murder. Over two days, the race will experience a 30% decrease in population and will be in a weakened state, perfect opportunity for thievery and chaos. * Any gods with domain over life and fortune can intervene, but can only save one race as agreed upon by those gods. * Dreka will have power to instantly cause 30% decrease in population as he sees fit by releasing the Nures (to the affected race) and Yuna will have power to prevent a race from suffering from this illness in the event of an outbreak. * Keema has power to stop all outbreak

#Limitations Carrion Flu does NOT affect the following races:

* Flora - protected by Yuna, consumes Naga Fruit * Holnareem - Metal cells cannot be penetrated by the virus * Donds - have 1/500th power of a god * Nures - As tasked by Dreka to bring death to old and weak creatures, they are granted special immunity by Keema * Firow - Is a living fire.. burns the virus * Gibbering - has no lungs * Slimelords * Zahrah - As a creature of misfortune, Keema grants immunity * Xaggonite - Ethereal beings, cannot be affected by the virus * Guardians of the Keys - Immortals * Ice elementals - Virus cannot penetrate ice.

The outbreak will cease after two days in god's time.
